details: China's economy grew 4.5% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, surpassing the 4.4% forecast and showing acceleration from the previous quarter. This positive economic data led to a rebound in investor confidence across global risk assets, including Asian equities and Nasdaq futures. Bitcoin also experienced a positive reaction, rising approximately 1.4% following the news, indicating renewed appetite for risk after recent tech-led market declines.
title: China's Q3 GDP Exceeds Estimates, Lifts Global Risk Assets and Bitcoin

details: The European Central Bank's (ECB) Governing Council is scheduled to meet on October 28-29, 2026, to decide on euro area interest rates. While further rate hikes were anticipated to combat inflation, recent turmoil in bond markets is independently pushing up borrowing costs. This dynamic could reduce the necessity for additional ECB rate increases. Currently, market pricing suggests a 99% probability that the ECB will keep interest rates unchanged at 2.50% at the upcoming meeting.
title: ECB Grapples with Bond Turmoil Ahead of October 29 Rate Decision

details: The US September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, released on October 14, 2026, revealed that annual inflation rose to 3.7%, exceeding the consensus forecast of 3.6%. This higher-than-expected inflation data has intensified concerns about potential additional interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. The news contributed to a rise in US Treasury yields and prompted a decline in risk-sensitive assets, with Bitcoin falling below $82,000 and other major cryptocurrencies also experiencing downward pressure.
title: US Inflation Exceeds Expectations at 3.7%, Fuels Fed Rate Hike Speculation
